claims.summary: For every m >= 2 and distinct nonzero a_1, a_2, a_3, the least-order joint recurrence L = sum_(s<=6) P_s(M) S^s of the three pair sequences g_ij of lem:cube-level-window-reduction has degree 6m+6; P_6(M) has exactly the rational roots m-15/2, ..., m-5/2 (simple), and P_0(M) exactly the rational roots 3m-5, ..., 3m-1 with 3m-3 double, independently of the moduli; the remaining factors of degree 6m have no rational roots for generic moduli.
claims.assessment: Conjecture: holds at eight points (m = 2..5, two root triples) modulo 1000003 on the grid j/d, d | 12, |j/d| <= 150 (research/results/bmd-20261009-ker/indicial-roots.txt); the roots at 0 follow from the weight recurrence, those at infinity from a heuristic expansion of the Euler integral (moments and the bulk exponent -2 lambda = -3).
claims.rationale: Reduces the root conditions of hypothesis (S) of lem:cube-triple-window-constraint-criterion to the moduli-dependent residual (apparent-singularity) factors.
claims.next_action: Compute the local solutions of L at infinity to prove the exponent multiset and the vanishing triangle, or desingularize L and redo the constraint criterion.
